summary: Graviton support is implemented for PyTorch and TensorFlow inference in the working tree; nothing is committed. Changes: src/sagemaker/image_uris.py adds _is_graviton_family(), routes Graviton families to a "graviton" processor, and swaps in the version's graviton repository/container suffix (tagging with "cpu") or falls back to the CPU image when a version has no graviton block. pytorch.json and tensorflow.json gain the graviton processor, new 1.12.1 (inference + training) and 2.9.1 (inference) entries with graviton blocks. New tests in tests/unit/sagemaker/image_uris/test_retrieve.py cover family detection and the expected URIs. Final run of image_uris, tensorflow, huggingface, test_pytorch and test_mxnet: 3630 passed, 612 skipped, 0 failed. Caveats: calling retrieve without an explicit version still fails (no default version); regular 1.12.1/2.9.1 CPU/GPU tags are unverified guesses; tests were run with a temporary /tmp mock shim since the shared venv lacks `mock` and imports the base/src copy of sagemaker, so the PYTHONPATH override was needed; black was unavailable, so formatting was checked by line length only.
